releaseNotes: Enhance server dashboard with resource telemetry and history tracking
changelog: Added new telemetry header for resource metrics.
Introduced animated progress indicators for CPU, Memory, Disk, and Network metrics.
Implemented history tracking for CPU, Memory, Disk, and Network usage in ServerViewModel.
Updated DashboardMetricCard to display historical data and dynamic footer messages based on resource usage.
Refactored shortcut tiles layout for better organization and clarity.
Improved visual feedback with appropriate icons and colors based on resource load.
